Wishy Home button
Lets Wishy open when you press Home on the remote. It only looks at the Home key. It does not read the screen or send anything anywhere.
Home button override
Override is on
Pressing Home on the remote opens Wishy, even if the TV keeps its own launcher.
Override is off
Turn on \"Wishy Home button\" in Android\'s Accessibility settings so Home opens Wishy on TVs that ignore the Home app choice.
Open Accessibility settings

Keeps the service on but lets Home go to the TV\'s own launcher.
Resume the override
